globalscope: Since 2010 to March 2022, RB Partners has been an exclusive representative of the international Association Globalscope in Russia, which includes 55 investment advisory firms from 48 countries specializing in mergers and acquisitions, strategic consulting, and corporate finance.
services:
• Business purchase support in Russia and abroad
  • Business sale support in Russia and abroad
  • Improving the efficiency of corporate governance, including issues of strategic planning
  • Development of a strategy for accessing foreign markets and turn-key support in negotiation processes. Setting-up alliances with the most appropriate partners in Asian countries. Support in export-import transactions
  • Advising on the relationship between shareholders (partners) in businesses, the division and exit from the business, as well as the entry of new shareholders (partners)
  • Raising bank loans and guarantees
  • Protection of rights / representation of interests of investors / creditors
  • Debt restructuring and refinancing
advantages:
1. A successful track record of over 90 completed M&A projects exceeding US$2.5 billion.
  2. A highly qualified team with extensive experience in business consulting, the real sector of the economy and M&A.
advantages_full:
1. The Company has been successfully operating on the market since 2004 and has over 500 completed advisory projects in improving the efficiency of corporate governance in various sectors of the economy.
  2. A successful track record of over 90 completed M&A projects exceeding US$2.5 billion.
  3. A highly qualified team of over 35 professionals with an extensive experience of working in business consulting, the real economy, and M&A.
  4. Independence. RB Partners is not affiliated with any state structure or financial and industrial group.
  5. Confidentiality. We provide the highest level of confidentiality.
team:
RB Partners has succeeded in assembling a team of diverse professionals. Our team brings together the knowledge and practical skills gained during a long-term experience at leading financial and manufacturing holdings, investment banks, and Big Four firms.

Out team strives to be on the same page with our clients, solving complex challenging tasks that arise in the course of work.
